QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Purchasing a Disguise
QuestInfo.0: What does #b#p2153000##k have to say? Go find out.
QuestInfo.1: #p2153000#, one of the Black Wing managers, says he'll sell you his #b#t1003134##k. With his hat, the gatekeepers will surely let you in. All you have to do is give him the dough.
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t1003134#. #p2153000#, laughing, said he'll sell you another if you ever need it. He really is an unpleasant man, but at least you can enter the mine now.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Complete #bPurchasing a Disguise (Mesos)#k or #bPurchasing a Disguise (Item)#k

0.0: See, I'm a member of the Black Wings. I'm allowed to enter the Mine. So, if you wear my hat, the gatekeepers won't stop you from entering.
0.1: But my hat isn't free. It'll cost you some Mesos. Or if you're hard up for cash, there's something else you could do... Get me #bPatrol Robot S Memory Chip#k x#r30#k from #rPatrol Robot S#k nearby. I need to log all the recordings on their voice chips. Just think of the hat as compensation for doing my job for me.
0.2: Of course it's fine. Black Wing management doesn't care who's doing the manual labor around here as long as it gets done. You collect the stuff, I get a break, and you get the hat, okay? Relax. We're killing two birds with one stone.

yes.0: I knew you'd react like that. Hehehe... Just bring me #rPatrol Robot S Memory Chips x30#k like I asked. It'll be easy. Of course, I got it for free but... This is a you problem. Just talk to me again when you've got them.

no.0: You don't have to buy it if you don't want to. There are a lot of others who want it.

1.0: Perfect. Here's the hat as promised.

yes.0: As long as you're wearing my hat, you can walk past the gatekeepers at the Mine Entrance like you own the place. They are the only ones on guard, so once you make it past them, no one will care what you're wearing. Hehe...
yes.1: If you lose the hat, come back to me. I'll have a replacement by then, and I'd be happy to work out another deal with you. Hehe...

default.0: What? You don't have them yet? Boy, did I pick the wrong customer. Don't you want to enter the mine?
